transfer.rationale: ST4 R4a checkpoint (frozen from the current-base scratch dry run before the move; reported with this commit under the operator's 2026-10-06 instruction to finish Settings with self-verification). App-to-hook transfer of the first-run configuration cluster (163 range lines, 160 non-blank, in four ranges) into settings/useFirstRunConfiguration.js with the plan's two layers: a state layer useFirstRunConfigurationState (0 inputs, 9 returns) called at the old state lines, because useTeamGroupSettings reads firstRunConfigurationActive while rendering (a single hook at the handler position fails lint with a use-before-define error and a first-render TDZ; that variant was built and measured), and a handlers layer useFirstRunConfiguration (50 inputs, 67 expanded, 10 returns) called at the old handler position, whose one effect crosses zero unmoved effects. The two late inputs, closeGroupManage and saveAllSettings, are handler-only getters. The first-run derived values, which the plan leaves in App unless a later decision claims them, move with the hook by decision (the alternative that leaves them in App was also built: 49 inputs, 7 lines smaller). restoreSettingsDraftsToCommittedBaselines and returnFromFirstRunConfigurationRecovery stay in App (ST5 rows), as do the keepMine* handlers, settingsSaveInFlightRef and the onboarding controller. The combined App-plus-owner total grows only by the 162-line scaffolding allowance. The dashboard.jsx lineCeiling stays 11754 until the slice's R5. The combined ceiling is measured-plus-allowance.
